'''Mino Ferrin''' was an individual who held the position of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was known to utilize his finances to oppress those he governed. He had a hidden facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] that maintained his secret accounts.<ref name="Generous Donations" />
